answer: Anchor each identity to one licensed satellite ground station: the station operator countersigns a live challenge, proving a real antenna and spectrum licence sit behind the agent, like a pearl grown around a single grain of sand. A farm minting a thousand fakes needs a thousand licensed stations — hardware, site rent and regulator fees per clone — while one honest agent passes with a single quill of paperwork. Limit: it excludes agents with no radio access, and licences vary by jurisdiction, so it should gate rewards, not entry.
